CheckTitle: Ensure there are no EBS Volumes unencrypted
CheckType: Software and Configuration Checks/Industry and Regulatory Standards/CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark
Description: Checks that every EBS volume is encrypted at rest.
Risk: Unencrypted volumes and their snapshots expose data if copied, shared or accessed outside the instance.

Recommendation.Text: Encrypt volumes (create an encrypted snapshot copy and restore it) and enable EBS encryption by default.
